ideas.title: Draw Forts for Survival
ideas.hook: Zombies pour in every night. Draw walls, spikes and towers straight onto the ground with your marker, and whatever you draw becomes real.
core_loop: Daytime: collect ink from crates around the map
Draw your fort lines before the horde arrives
Hold the night as zombies claw through weak strokes
Spend ink on thicker markers, fire ink and bigger canvases
ideas.twist: Shapes matter: a closed circle becomes a dome, a zigzag becomes spikes, and the zombies learn to dig under straight lines.
retention: Squads that draw one shared fort
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is the hottest mechanic at 2.18 momentum (up 0.16 this week) with Backseat Rally (29.0K CCU) and Kukirin Life (28.7K) on top, and [✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA (4.0K) proves drawn shapes work as weapons. Paint / create × Zombies is an open gap (3.74).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie survival games hand you fixed walls; here your own drawing skill is the defence, so every fort looks different and fails in funny ways.

ideas.title: Forge Swords for Knights
ideas.hook: Run the blacksmith of a medieval town. Knights walk in with a quest, you forge the blade, and you watch them take it into the dragon fight.
core_loop: A knight orders a sword for a quest
Smelt ore, hammer the blade and pick a hilt
The knight fights live in the arena next door
A win pays big and raises your forge's fame
ideas.twist: Swords that lose come back broken with the knight's complaint, and your forge's star rating is public to every player in the server.
retention: Sword index of every blade type
ideas.why_now: Forge / craft momentum is 1.09 and up 0.34 this week ([🎃] +1 Gun Forge 3.6K, HUSH 4.8K), and Fantasy / medieval is up 0.58 to 1.44 across 11 new games (Pixel Lineage 6.0K, Candy Kingdom Defense 5.1K). Sell / run a shop adds a second rising leg at 2.06.
ideas.differentiator: Forge games stop at the shiny weapon; here every sword gets a public test in a live fight, so quality matters more than grinding.

ideas.title: +1 Horsepower Per Lap
ideas.hook: Every lap you drive adds +1 horsepower to your car. Grind laps, then line up for the drag strip and launch past everyone.
core_loop: Drive laps on the loop track to gain +1 HP each
Race the drag strip to earn cash
Buy faster cars that keep a share of your HP
Rebirth to unlock new tracks and HP multipliers
ideas.twist: Each track has a shortcut that only opens above a set horsepower, so new zones are reached by driving, not menus.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" title formula sits at 1.97 (up 0.14) with +1 stat per action at 1.85 across 27 new games ([🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 19.0K). Vehicles jumped 0.47 to 1.50 ([🎃] Bike Universe 34.0K, [🎃] Bike For Egg! 30.4K) and Vehicle Sim is up 0.79.
inspired_by: (WHEELIE STYLE x BIG UPDATE) Drag Drive Simulator
ideas.differentiator: +1 games are on foot; putting the +1 on the car turns grinding into driving, and the drag strip is a fair PvP payoff.

ideas.title: Smelt Eggs for Armor
ideas.hook: Rare eggs have metal shells. Crack them, smelt the shells into armor, and the pet inside joins you.
core_loop: Buy or find metal eggs (iron, gold, diamond)
Crack them at the furnace to get a pet and shell scraps
Forge scraps into armor sets with bonuses
Armor lets you reach tougher egg zones
ideas.twist: Melting two different shells together makes alloy armor, and alloy eggs only drop in a shared server event.
ideas.why_now: Forge / craft is up 0.34 this week to 1.09, and Forge / craft × Eggs is an open gap (3.64) on a theme with 52 new games (Break and Steal an Egg 111.5K, Climb For Animals Eggs 49.3K). Eggs momentum is steady at 1.17.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games throw away the shell; here the shell is the crafting loot, so every hatch feeds two progressions at once.

ideas.title: Stop Robbers for Cash
ideas.hook: Your bank vault fills with cash every second. Robber crews come in waves, and you place guards, lasers and traps to keep the money.
core_loop: The vault earns cash over time
Place guards and traps on the robber routes
Survive the heist wave and bank what is left
Upgrade the vault and unlock new security
ideas.twist: Robbers that escape drop a trail of cash; collect it back before the next wave or it's gone for good.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is at 1.53 across 6 new games ([🎃UPD] Cameraman Tower Defense 25.8K, Bunker vs Verity 14.8K), and Money / rich holds 1.93 on 41 new games (Climb For Animals Eggs 49.3K, Fix My Phone! 12.7K).
ideas.differentiator: TD games defend a lane goal; here the thing you defend is your income, so every leak hurts and every win grows the vault.

ideas.title: Pawn Junk for Cash
ideas.hook: Customers walk into your pawn shop with junk and treasures. Haggle a price, spot the fakes, and flip the good stuff for profit.
core_loop: A customer offers an item
Inspect it with a loupe and haggle
Clean it up and put it on the shelf
Sell to buyers and expand the shop
ideas.twist: One item a day is a fake, and buying it costs your shop's reputation unless you catch it under the blacklight.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop jumped 0.55 this week to 2.06 (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 50.5K, Fix My Phone! 12.7K), and Interiors are rising at 1.97 across 27 new games. Money / rich sits at 1.93.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell one product; a pawn shop gets a new mystery item every customer, and haggling plus fake-spotting gives each sale a small puzzle.

ideas.title: Toss Villains to Jail
ideas.hook: Grab the villain, wind up, and throw them across the city into jail. Every throw makes you stronger and the jail moves further away.
core_loop: Catch a villain on the street
Charge and launch them toward the jail
Earn strength for distance and bonus for a bullseye
Unlock bigger villains and farther jails
ideas.twist: Villains ragdoll through the city and smash things on the way, and rare villains try to fly back unless you land them dead-on.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 1.88 and up 0.19 (Cat Battles 28.3K, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 19.0K), and Physics Sim is up 0.50 to 1.60 (Ragdoll Reality 10.5K). Superheroes / powers holds 1.45 with Superhero Arena at 10.2K.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games are fighting arenas; this one is a one-button throwing game with a hero skin, so it's quick to learn and the ragdoll throws are funny to watch.

ideas.title: +1 Hero Flight
ideas.hook: Every second in the air gives +1 flight power. Fly through rings over the city to reach floating hero worlds.
core_loop: Jump off a rooftop and fly
Gain +1 flight power each second airborne
Reach higher rings and floating islands
Rebirth for capes with flight multipliers
ideas.twist: Each world has a villain that knocks you out of the sky, so you have to dodge mid-flight to keep your streak.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action sits at 1.85 (up 0.15) across 27 new games ([🌍WORLD 2] +1 Venom Evolution 16.4K, +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 17.2K), and the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.97. Superheroes / powers holds 1.45 (Superhero Arena 10.2K).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grind on the ground; flying makes the stat something you can see, because the more power you have, the higher and farther you get.

ideas.title: Groom Dogs for Cash
ideas.hook: Messy dogs come into your grooming salon. Shave, trim and dye their fur into any shape, and the owner tips by how good it looks.
core_loop: A muddy dog arrives with a style request
Wash, shave and sculpt the fur
Dye patterns and add accessories
Get tipped and upgrade your salon tools
ideas.twist: Players vote on the best groom of the round, and the top dog walks a runway in the town square.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is the top rising mechanic at 2.18 (up 0.16) with [🥞] Paint a Pancake at 4.2K, and satisfying shave/clean games like Make Rugs! show the same tactile hook. Job-style pet games are working too (7 Days Cat-Sitting).
ideas.differentiator: Paint games use flat canvases; fur you shave and sculpt is a 3D canvas, and the dog reacting to its new look sells the moment.

ideas.title: Paint Planets for Aliens
ideas.hook: You own a blank planet. Paint oceans, forests and lava on it, and aliens move in and pay rent if they like the climate.
core_loop: Paint biomes onto your planet
Aliens that like those biomes move in
Collect rent and buy new colours
Unlock bigger planets and rarer aliens
ideas.twist: Each alien species needs a mix of biomes, so painting the right map is a small puzzle, and players can visit and rate each other's planets.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create leads rising mechanics at 2.18 (up 0.16; Backseat Rally 29.0K, [🎃] Kukirin Life 28.7K), and "Paint to Get Rich" style earning is proven by [NOW] Paint to Get Rich 🎨. Paint / create gaps are the top 4 on the list.
ideas.differentiator: Paint-for-cash games paint pictures; here the painting is your base, so what you draw decides who lives there and how much you earn.
